append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1666). PREMISE RE-TESTED on main at 2d3fd02f2: no week-over-week read for a member anywhere under app/(main)/crew, lib/economy or lib/quest (the Circle board in lib/quest/effort.ts compares this week with a 4-week median, per circle, not this week with last on the member’s own stats). BUILT AT READ TIME, NO MIGRATION: zap_transactions is an append-only ledger indexed on profile_id, so a member’s last 14 days is a small indexed read; a weekly snapshot table plus cron would be a second copy of a number the ledger already produces. lib/economy/week-over-week.ts (pure) sums the last 7 x 24 hours and the 7 before with the Circle board windows (weekBucket), ignoring non-positive rows; lib/economy/ledger.ts getZapWeeks reads the 14 days with the user-scoped client (RLS owner-only) and returns null on error so no false zero shows. The Vault Zaps card now carries N this week and a delta: N more than last week (up), Same as last week, or Last week: N (flat, never a red arrow). Still four tiles. TESTS: lib/economy/week-over-week.test.ts.
